summary: Iteration 47: Tested Rokad passbook register + Overdraft Alert (backend pytest 7/7 + Playwright UI). All requested features WORK: headers Debit (Gaya)/Credit (Aaya), no Balance column in 'All' view; all-accounts summary order Account|Opening|Debit (Gaya)|Credit (Aaya)|Closing; selecting CASH IN HAND shows Balance column + opening row, rows chronological, running balance = prev + credit - debit (0 mismatches), Cr suffix positive / Dr negative (verified with a ₹99,99,99,999 overdraft row showing ₹99,02,95,020.00 Dr in red), totals = sums, rokad-closing-cell == bank-closing. Overdraft: huge payment -> confirm 'OVERDRAFT ALERT — CASH IN HAND ... Phir bhi save karein?'; Cancel -> nothing saved (API verified), OK -> saved, then deleted via UI. ₹100 payment and huge receipt -> no confirm. Editing an existing payment to huge amount -> confirm also fires; edit to 150 -> no confirm, saved. Excel: single sheet 'Cash Book' with 'Debit (Gaya)'/'Credit (Aaya)' columns and correct values. Day Book toggle renders DOS sheet, slip/edit/delete work. One minor race found (stale summary). All test data cleaned up.

minor.issue: cash_account_name is not derived server-side from cash_account_id. Entries created via the API without it show 'A/C : -' on the voucher slip, an empty 'Cash A/C' cell in Excel, and no [account] tag in the register.
The dr_cr field returns 'Dr' for a positive cash balance, which is the opposite of the UI's passbook rule (positive = Cr). The frontend ignores this field, but other consumers would get it wrong.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: neither request ignores stale responses. Changing From/To quickly (seen in run 1 when both dates were filled within about 100ms of page load) let the initial today..today accounts-summary response arrive last. The page then showed the wrong opening (97,04,979 instead of 96,99,945) and '—' for Debit/Credit in the all-accounts table. bank-opening/bank-closing were wrong and rokad-closing-cell (97,10,013) did not match bank-closing (97,04,979). Not reproducible with normal waits. Fix: use a request-id/AbortController guard or check that the dates still match before calling setSummary/setEntries.

issues: total-baki shows a negative net as '₹ -99,99,96,199.00' (minus sign after ₹), unlike the Dr/Cr style used elsewhere
The sheet has no Opening/Balance column even when one account is selected, and the subtitle shows the FY instead of the selected date range/account. Optional enhancement.

action_items: Add a stale-response guard to load()/loadSummary() in RokadPanna.jsx so out-of-order responses cannot overwrite the current date range
(minor) Backend POST/PUT /rokad: fill cash_account_name from cash_account_id when it is missing
(minor) Align the /ledgers/{id}/balance dr_cr field with the passbook convention, or document it
(optional) The overdraft check only uses the balance as on the entry date. A back-dated payment that is fine on that date but pushes later balances negative is not flagged.
critical_code_review_comments: RokadPanna.jsx is 794 lines (over 700). Consider moving the entry form modal into its own component.
The overdraft check is frontend-only. The API accepts any payment (by design: 'Warning + confirm'), so other entry paths (TransferForm, VoucherSearch edit, bill payments) do not warn.
_compute_party_balance uses to_list(5000) for bills/rokad/dos_journal, so ledgers with more than 5000 entries would be silently truncated

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows pass; 1 intermittent race condition)

seed_data_creation: Created QA REG PARTY + rokad entries (5000 jama, 1200 kharch, 100->150 kharch, 999999999 kharch/jama) on 2026-06-20 CASH IN HAND. All deleted. CASH IN HAND balance restored to 97,01,179.
